title: Weird ass Walmart dreams
content: It's like Walmart, but bigger. I go to Walmart a lot, so it must be something like that. I don't know it's name. When I watched the loud house alot, I had a dream in this place where I saw Lincoln on gold fish. I also saw strange crayons with glittery green plastic around them. They were like grips. I know for sure that the store has round thingys with post cards and birthday cards, it looks pretty cool. Another dream I had was at target, but it gave me the vibe of the same store. I was at Walmart with some friends and my dad. My dad and I lost my friends, so we bought all of the same things my friends bought and I got a free Roblox account. Very strange. This store isn't uncomfortable, but it also is very weird, and is almost liminal. The target dream felt much more comfortable.
